Bill.BriefDescription: Providing certain public notices in other than English.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to providing public notices of public health,safety, and welfare in a language other than English; and adding a newsection to chapter 1.20 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 1.20 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) State agencies shall provide public notices, whether requiredby law or rule, in a language other than English if a significantsegment of the affected community or area is of limited Englishproficiency and speaks a language other than English. This requirementis only for notices that involve a public health, safety, or welfareconcern, including, but not limited to, proposed locations offacilities that would house sex offenders, or proposed locations forcriminal facilities. (2) "Significant segment," for purposes of this section, means fivepercent or more of the citizens living in the affected community orarea who speak a language other than English, or ten thousand or more p. 1 HB 2863individuals residing in the county who speak a language other thanEnglish.
